email.subject: Trusty Plumbing site: two quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I checked Trusty Plumbing's site. Two things are likely costing you calls: it's not mobile-friendly, so anyone searching for a plumber on their phone (most people, especially in an emergency) has a hard time even reading it, and there's no way to book online, so those visitors either call during business hours or just leave for a competitor's site.

I also noticed no reviews are shown and the footer looks out of date.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's happening and what I'd do?

Alex
